headline: US stocks set to open higher as AI-led rebound gathers pace after CoreWeave earnings beat in quiet Veterans Day data calendar
raw_text:
- S&P 500 (@ES) futures are up 0.65%, Dow Jones (@YM) futures up 0.07%, Nasdaq 100 (@NQ) futures up 1.53%, and Russell 2000 (@ER2) futures up 0.48%, pointing to a gap-up open led by technology after CoreWeave’s results eased AI slowdown concerns.
- CoreWeave (CRWV) is up about 11% pre-market after reporting Q3 revenue of $3.66 billion, a 168% year-over-year increase that beat estimates, and raising full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0–$13.3 billion with adjusted operating income of $1.275–$1.375 billion.
- AI infrastructure names Nebius (NBIS) and IREN (IREN) also climb in pre-market trading following CoreWeave’s stronger-than-expected Q3 results and raised long-term outlook.
- Estee Lauder (EL) advances after raising its annual sales and profit outlook, supported by resilient demand for premium skincare products.
- Rivian (RIVN) gains in early trade after UBS (UBS) upgrades the stock to Buy and sets a $17 price target.
- Check Point Software (CHKP) edges slightly higher pre-market after being named a Leader in Forrester’s Q4 2026 Enterprise Firewall Solutions Wave report.
- Around 20 companies, including CGI/CGI Group (GIB), Riskified (RSKD) and Oddity Tech (ODD), are scheduled to report earnings before the bell, with their results expected to influence early trading.
- No major US economic data releases are scheduled amid the Veterans Day federal holiday, keeping focus on individual stock catalysts and AI and tech momentum.
- Asian markets trade mixed with the Nikkei advancing, while European bourses post modest gains and limited moves in oil (@CL) and gold (@GC) show little spillover into equities.
